fixes.whatChanged: Replaced the underflow-prone scan loop with a bounded helper, added overlap-aware scanning across chunk boundaries, and moved the 4 KB scan buffer off the kernel stack.
sideEffects: Scan now allocates a nonpaged buffer and can return STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES if allocation fails.
fixes.notes: Minimal behavior-preserving fix with a safer scan implementation.

fixes.whatChanged: Replaced invalid Array.Copy-based response decoding with raw struct-byte serialization via MemoryMarshal and added two regression tests covering byte and string decoding.
sideEffects: Added a new managed test project to the solution.

fixes.whatChanged: Restructured ReadWithProtect into a cleanup-based flow that always restores protection after a successful protection change and now surfaces restore failures when they are the only failure.
sideEffects: ReadWithProtect can now return the restore failure instead of silent success when the read succeeds but the protection restore fails.
fixes.notes: This is a correctness improvement to the protect-read-restore contract.

fixes.whatChanged: Removed the global silent-mode state and threaded per-request silent flags through driver operations and logging calls.
sideEffects: Non-response IOCTLs no longer fabricate bytesReturned output in the driver.
fixes.notes: This eliminates request-to-request log suppression races.
